name: Input
description: Single-line text field and input group. Works for every native input type (text, password, email, search, tel, url, file…) and supports inline addons, icons and action buttons.

classes.ayy-input-group: Root for an input with inline addons, icons or buttons. Draws the field (border, fill, radius, height) and the focus ring while its .ayy-input is focused.
classes.ayy-input-group__addon: Text beside the input: a prefix (https://), a suffix (USD, %) or a Kbd hint. Muted, one line.

default.looks: Wash fill, 1px line-strong border, control radius; placeholder in muted at 70%. In an input group, addons and icons are muted and the input loses its own border.

pressed.none: Text fields have no pressed look; the caret shows where you are. Trailing buttons keep their own pressed look.

focus.looks: 2px ring drawn just inside the edge (-1px offset); the border goes transparent. In an input group, the ring moves to the group container.

error.looks: Border 60% destructive; the focus ring turns destructive. Forced colours: dashed border.

loading.none: No loading look. While a value is checked (a username), use an Input group with a small Spinner as its addon.

scale.sm: Control sm height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), tighter padding, sm text.
scale.md: Control md height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
scale.lg: Control lg height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), more padding, lg text.

sizes.density: Height and text size follow data-density; touch keeps md text at 16px so iOS doesn't zoom.
sizes.width: Fills its container (inline-size 100%); set a max-inline-size in rem for short values.

js: inputClass({ size?, className? }) → string; inputGroupClass({ size?, className? }) → string; inputGroupAddonClass constant.

props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" (visual size; native size attr not exposed)

a11y: Every input needs a label: wrap in a Field with a Label (for/id), or aria-label for search boxes.
The input inside an InputGroup still needs its own label; icons and addons do not name it.
Errors: aria-invalid="true" + aria-describedby pointing at the error text.
Action buttons inside an InputGroup (show password, clear) must have an accessible aria-label and aria-pressed where applicable.
do: Use an input for short free-text entry: names, URLs, search, API keys, passwords.
Use an InputGroup when an input needs a leading icon, a prefix/suffix unit, or a trailing action button.
Match the input size to neighbouring buttons in a toolbar (sm with sm).
dont: Don't use an input for multi-line text — use Textarea.
Don't use an input for on/off — use Switch.
Don't use placeholder as the label.
Don't hardcode widths in px inside flexible layouts — the input fills its container.
Don't use an input for picking dates or times — use Date & time picker (DatePicker, DateRange, TimePicker, DateTimePicker).
Don't stack more than one addon on each side of an InputGroup.
Don't put a primary action button inside an InputGroup — place a Button next to it.
